source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Increasing how much ammonia the body actually absorbs from within the gastrointestinal tract rather than excreting it","B":"Carrying fairly little established relationship to the client's serum ammonia levels despite being prescribed for that reason","C":"Directly reversing the underlying liver damage that originally caused the client's hepatic encephalopathy to develop","D":"Trapping ammonia in the colon and promoting its excretion through increased bowel movements, reducing serum ammonia levels"}}
source_row.rationale: Lactulose works by trapping ammonia in the colon (through an acidifying effect that converts ammonia to the less-absorbable ammonium) and promoting its excretion through increased bowel movements, reducing serum ammonia levels and improving hepatic encephalopathy symptoms.
source_row.source_detail: Mechanism of Action in Hepatic Encephalopathy
